statement: A guard-deletion test proves a guard only if its fixture reaches that guard. The card asked for a vendored node_modules package.json fixture to show A1's authored-path filter keeps vendored workspace manifests out; with the filter deleted that test stayed green, because the scan inventory hard-excludes node_modules before any collector sees it. Only a generated/ manifest, which reaches the collector, turned red. Rule: for each guard deletion, confirm the test fails with the guard removed, and when it does not, find which upstream control is actually doing the work and add a fixture that reaches the guard you meant to test.

Before reading a before/after delta from an ad hoc measurement pipeline, make it reproduce a number already committed. Scoring the expanded behaviour corpus under the old and new scanners gave per-rubric fingerprints, but those were only trustworthy once the same pipeline, run without the new specimen, reproduced all ten committed fingerprints exactly. Rule: a measurement script earns trust by matching the existing pins first; only then report what moved.
